name: Taitexma TH260 Bulky
shortHtml:
At 9mm this Taitexma (tie-tex-ma) machine is the perfect gauge for popular hand knitting and hand-spun yarns.

Metal bed, this machine will provide years of service.
Get all of the domestic knitting machine functionality with minimal fuss.
